No additional defect was confirmed in this pass. I reviewed the remaining storage and macro edge cases; the issues already documented cover the highest-impact cases.

The audit remains at 25 confirmed findings:

- snapshot corruption and its randomized crash reproduction,
- persistent failed-write leakage and immediate suffix deletion,
- LFU clone and LRU bincode cache-transfer failures,
- runtime timeout retry duplication and subscriber cleanup defects,
- reconfiguration, trim, configuration, serialization, and API-boundary defects.

All reproduction sources, commands, and retained logs are referenced from [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_22-19-35-omnipaxos-baseline/work/report.md).
